evidence.note: Government full text quotes1898Flag Act§1 red field, dark-blue cross with white border,16:22ratio and dimensions; §2 distinguishes this merchant ensign from split-and-tongued state flag. Interior post-union1906–1939 excludes wartime occupation and does not assert that the rectangular civil ensign is the state ensign.
Individual public-domain licensing and design read; original asset acquired unchanged. The SVG supplies visual provenance, not historical chronology.
